bits.text: The queen of Kryta called for a ceremony that attracted many unexpected guests.
The charr have many Weapons but perhaps the only Weapon they need is the genius of their automobile engineering.
The sacrifices of the norn's greatest heroes spills out of their Steadings giving Karma to us all.
The pride of the Arcane Council must be the height of the asuran technologies; those precious gates of theirs.
Those sylvari following the Maker's Path might look out from the terrace and find that what brings them the most Karma is that of creating life from dirt and sun.
Only an Ornithologist of questionable sanity would study a risen chicken.
When dusk fell upon the Zephyrites and the last gleam of moonglow lit their way, only prosperity could save them.

bits.text: Under a glass sky the journey begins again, footsteps placed upon footprints, the mad following the mad.
In shadowed shallows beneath the gardens, the detritus of Lion's Arch lurks.
Search the dead streets and forgotten thoroughfares of another Lion's Arch.
Say more now and look more where Kryta's descendants are buried.
Go into the hills and set down black roots in stagnant waters.
Find Provernic, where the first king's bones rot in the hills.

bits.text: Stories yet untold despite the tower that marks a spooky site. When humans flee their home of old, where they settle cannot be told.
This hinterland village was home to a goddess and a martyr.
These old bones are caught in the gullet, where laughing rises from sorrow.
The landing at Arca struggles to fill its storeroom so it will never starve again.
Green is the color I want to remember. Not the red of flames or the blackened plateau. The bridge, even it was green.
Walk in cadence with King Thorn's shattered subjects. They keep their hatred deep within.

bits.text: "Brave the dead land to claim the foot of the swiftest." Albax pointed north, toward the Cursed Shore of Orr.
"Find the former walker of the blasted land, and gain a symbol of new growth." Albax shrugged while talking of the Branded landscape of the Iron Marches.
"In homes in pale parchment hills, find the form of an old survivor in the hands of a young one." Albax smiled, thinking of the rivers of Timberline Falls.
"In lush lands wracked with waste, ask for that which glitters in their patron's gaze." Albax's eyes opened wide picturing the dangers of Mount Maelstrom.
"The noble bird has been swept from solitude into the hands of chaos." Albax hinted at the monks of Shing Jea.
"The porcelain feline beckons you toward service in the name of the savory." Albax mentioned the smell of food in New Kaineng City.
"Bathed in gold and hubris, luck itself will lead you to me." Albax described a special room of games in Arborstone.
"In the sea of green, among the scaly ones, a relic lies with the mistakes of one's past." Albax gestured at the Jade Sea all around him.
"A sacred weapon is held in the boughs of great trees, never to be turned against them." Albax spoke of the verdant sights of the Maguuma Jungle.
"The needy hold tight to a hope of plenty in a pitiless golden land." Albax cringed while thinking of the heat in the Crystal Desert.

bits.text: Dadga needs to speak with you in the Wizard's Tower.
All convoys must have a starting point, just as all climbs must have a place where you can start your ascent.

Flying books, treaties on centaur mating rituals, six hundred and fifty-seven thousand, eight hundred and ninety-one words about the uses of moa feathers can be found here. What else could be found between the shelves?
Someone in Amnytas is going beyond just closing rifts, but one must weigh the pros and cons of probing the unknown. Help them survive the ordeal.
Reports of wizard magic in Frostgorge Sound, just the smallest drop in a sea. A sorrowful one has found a prize...
Nobody knows what is stashed in the depths of deepest halls of knowledge, but someone in Amnytas is trying to find out...
Skywatch Archipelago is the gateway to many realities, but it would be folly to assume this tower was "the" tower.
The Kryptis flood the skies; the Heart thrums whenever they are near. Hunt down their incursions across the bastions or fractals and find your prize
Wizards fight with more than spells and swords—they concoct all sorts of brews as well. Seek out and aid this master while they test their creations.
Many things whisper in Amnytas that should not: doors, books, and spirits. Hunt them down and trace their source.
Buried in Rata Sum are many labs, but this one is so full of memory, it hurts.
Among the fractals of the archipelago, enormous amounts of emotional energy is coalescing. Help the gatherers and find your answers.
Magic can be used to heal, transmute, and inspire, but for this bastion, they focus on battle. Learn the poses and complete the spell.
If only magical barriers were as easy to maintain as waving a wand. It takes work and undying focus, and these barriers must not fall.
The queen's shadows meet in secret under the Shadow of Grenth.
A hobby that requires only two things: patience and water. Maybe a clue can be found if one also takes the practice?
Rifts let things through and others in. Search the fields where the fiend vanished, and someone nearby may have some answers.
The tower climbs high and holds infinite secrets. If one climbs high enough, maybe those secrets will reveal themselves...
If one is looking for the stars, there is only one bastion where they are found.
The charr have always shunned the rejects in their citadel; search the shadows thoroughly and cast a light to those creatures in the darkness.
Magic in Amnytas is always temperamental, but with the Kryptis attack it's running amok. Once statuesque, this place needs a helping hand.
Amnytas is suffering, but those who seek balance are suffering worst of all. Why debate it? Break open the hall and help them find peace.
The beast emerges, the spire entwined... Put out the eyes, each and every one.
Now that you have found every card, return to Dagda in the Wizard's Tower.

bits.text: 1. Speak to the Kryptis delegation and accept their request.
2. Dash through five apple trees in Queensdale on your skyscale.
3. Rummage for ramen around Jade Mech Habitation Zone 03.
4. Convince Sous-Chef Seimur Oxbone to give you some bloodstone condiments. Speak with Astral Ward Culinary Specialist Torchmarrow in the Wizard's Tower to track where the sous-chef is each day.
5. Obtain some healthy (and edible) greenery from Narcisse in the Botanical Skygarden in Amnytas.
6. Obtain a keg of norn ale from Kevach's Homestead in Wayfarer Foothills.
7. Convince Grand Archivist Vivienne in the Wizard's Vault to give you a crate of ancient eggs.
8. Shoot the crate of ancient eggs that flies above Maelstrom's Core in Mount Maelstrom with your skyscale's Fireball skill, and pick the eggs out of the magma below before they burn.
9. Defeat 5 crabs with your skyscale's Fireball skill in Bloodtide Coast to flash-sear their meat.
10. Obtain a chunk of karka carapace from inside Bakestone Cavern in Southsun Cove.
11. Return to the Kryptis delegation after completing all previous steps to witness their feast.

bits.text: Talk to Astral Ward Medic Miyrna at Bloodcoast Ward in Lion's Arch or at Mantle's Arrival in Bava Nisos to start.
Didn't you have to scale this Monument to have a skyscale egg experience acrophobia? Luckily, we took a small detour to look at some flowers.
Keeping your balance while carrying an explosive keg through the Depths was quite a challenge, not to mention the large wurm heads.
The only thing Hidden about this place was those branches. So many roller beetles were caught on them.
We had our own vista with a view of the Bay, the market, the hylek, and the tengu.
I am thirsty from all the walking we did, but I would not trust any of the Water here.
I couldn't participate in that fest after seeing all those cattle. I'd rather just visit a different Town and have strawberries.
When you thought you were close to the Peak, a dredge would knock you back.
The Prospect of something happening to what you call home is a scary thought.
There sure are a lot of smashed chickens, as if someone was intentionally triggering Cave-ins.
There were so many of them on that bridge, I am surprised they weren't called the Baelfire Legion.
They said "Watch the ledges," so we did. It's a nice view despite seeing the chaos in the Tundra when that ice dragon was around.
How many walls did you think were Bluffing you? I really thought this mountain was the entrance.
I don't know what I hated the most in the Woods: the spiders, the bandit with the pistol, or the skritt that threw bears.
I wanted to Run around this place but felt I was being chased by either a suspicious charr or some anomaly-looking thing.
It was peaceful here in the Meadows, but now you can get a good look at the ruins of a fort and tower.
She thought it was a False hope that we could stop the Twisted Marionette.
Getting to that vista seemed like it was another hidden Garden jumping puzzle back in our day.
If I was participating in Hunger Royale, a Wild idea would be to hang around a potato farm.
We needed to go back to the Coil and look for more clues on this "Mordremoth."
Why did they have so much garlic bread in the catacombs? Do you think we will find more in the Ruins of their city?
You took a break at some Heartwoods, but adventurers were already taking out trolls, boars, bandits, wasps, oakhearts, and spiders.
There's something surreal about hanging around inside an abandoned building, but at least you can hear Owls.
It did not feel good chasing a karka back to a Cavern where there could have been more dangers lying in wait.
If I was on the cliffs, I would be safe from any tidal waves that crashed on the Coast. It would be a disaster if you couldn't find any launch pads in time.
Using the Catacombs as a shortcut probably wasn't the best idea. It's like a maze down there.
Sometimes you were Desperate and needed to get airship support when defending your fort.
To think Mordremoth could destroy a fort so Rapidly, and now we can't use the waypoint anymore!
Have you seen Issormir? That is a large wurm. It is worth the Climb.
Return to Astral Ward Medic Miyrna at Bloodcoast Ward in Lion's Arch or at Mantle's Arrival in Bava Nisos.

I told you somewhere in Tyria, not en Route to a literal Moon. You're looking for a skritt-friend of a skritt friend, which probably is someone that exhibits skritt-like behavior, such as hoarding and appreciating shinies.

bits.text: Speak with Historian Meliza.
The remnants of a ritual can be found due south of the hunting camp in Untamed Crags.
The Inquest dug up a broken totem, but left it behind. Meliza said the dig site is northwest of the Priory's camp in Crumbling Precipice.
Meliza thought she saw an ancient plate sticking out of the dirt west of the Inquest's Command Complex. She was on her skimmer, so it was likely along the ravine.
There's an ancient ritual bowl in a clearing just north of the Enchanting Grottoes. Be wary of the medusoid stingers, though; the camps are running out of salve.
While being chased by Inquest, Meliza dropped an old ritual coin near a waterfall just east of the Command Complex. If you retrieve it, she'll be grateful.
Researchers from the Priory recovered some seer belongings near a ley-infused tree by the Twin Geysers in Tranquil Glen.
A biologist from the Astral Ward noticed some seer garb beneath a massive, ancient tree just north of the camp in Shimmering Basin.
A heavily corroded weapon is protected by enormous, hostile beetles where two streams converge east of the Priory camp in Crumbling Precipice.
Narcisse thought she saw the choya carrying an old grimoire while she was observing their dancing. What could they need it for...
Archeologists stationed at the camp near the Shimmering Basin have unearthed strange glowing rocks. Meliza would like to observe one up close.

Skimmers value loyalty. Find and return a package hauled by a wavehawk. The Hullgardeners say one was left near a rock between the sands and the arches.
Skimmers need frequent feedings to stay strong and healthy. Find a fishing net that needs repairs. It's submerged just south of where crabs are made kings.
Find a toy that skimmers like to play with, likely fallen to the beach from where the juvenile wavehawk was playing in the pond above.
As with all skimmers, Castoran wavehawks are affectionate—help a young one in need, and you'll receive an item as thanks. The wavehawk was last seen somewhere northwest of Morningrise Prow.

item_descs.100219: Gain concentration after granting a boon to an ally.

item_descs.100245: Unlocks this skyscale mount skin for your account.
item_descs.100268: Addiction, loss, determination... The one lost to the abyss; her father mourns. Perhaps a clue can be found at the scene of the tragedy.
item_descs.100276: There is a small stone in Ascalon, in the remains of a tower. It is vitally important that it not be found by scavengers.
item_descs.100277: This item only has value as part of a collection.
item_descs.100287: Clarity and composure, the young dragon faces many challenges that weigh on them. But this mind is often spilt in two. Help him regain balance.
item_descs.100301: Banished from their world and cast adrift, his loving soul and webbed hands turned to nurture his new allies.
item_descs.100311: Summon a rock dog while in combat.
item_descs.100322: Inner calm, the strength to master one's self, and the will to push forward. He was guided by these things to protect his home.
item_descs.100327: Unlocks the skyscale mount for use throughout Tyria.
item_descs.100334: Talk to Isgarren and accept his request.
item_descs.100345: After dodge rolling in combat or evading an attack, your next attack is guaranteed to be a critical hit. <c=@reminder>(Cooldown: 1 Second)</c>

Grants a large amount of Secrets of the Obscure Mastery experience.

<c=@Flavor>Assumed to be minted by the Astral Ward, these are valued by collectors, scholars, and coin enthusiasts.</c>

item_descs.100520: Patience and moderation share a tune with the natural rhythm of the world. This card can be found where those who study nature reside.

item_descs.77689: <c=@flavor>Brewed from an ancient Elonian recipe, Istan Pale Ale is full of bitter hops with a unique citrus finish. The perfect beer for a summer day.</c>
item_descs.77694: <c=@flavor>Every celebration should include a brew that's finely crafted for the occasion, and Queen's Jubilale suits that perfectly. A strong, medium-bodied brew with flavors of molasses, light spice, and roasted, dark fruit that will quickly make it a favorite.</c>
item_descs.77716: <c=@flavor>Brewed from ingredients that include Kryta's finest pumpkins, Mad King's Pumpkin Porter delivers a preferable alternative to the trickster spirits tormenting Lion's Arch.</c>
item_descs.77719: <c=@flavor>A strong citrus ale brewed with citrus found across Tyria. A small amount of Bloodstone dust included in the brew provides a tingling sensation when swallowed.</c>
item_descs.77720: A collection of items in celebration of your dedication to the Eldvin Monastery Brew of the Month Club.
item_descs.77735: <c=@flavor>Rytlager Brimstout is a potent and unforgiving brew, much like its heroic namesake. It's also safe to assume that the brewers were well into their supply before deciding on the name.</c>
item_descs.77740: <c=@flavor>A dark and festive brew re-created from an ancient Canthan recipe. This strong brew provides a flavor that reminds many of times long past and is perfect for cold nights with stars littering the sky.</c>
item_descs.77762: Double-click to activate a one-time firework. Cannot be used in WvW.
item_descs.77766: <c=@flavor>Ogden Stonehealer reached out the Eldvin Monastery to re-create a beer that was an old dwarven favorite. This dark stout contains complex flavors of molasses, roasted coffee, and drops of licorice without being bitter or overly sweet. Surprisingly, the flavor strongly evolves with the temperature of the brew.</c>
item_descs.77768: <c=@flavor>Bash dragons and celebrate your victories by drinking this unique barley wine! Its mild body and rich fruity flavors will always leave you wanting another sip, which can be dangerous, much like fighting dragons.</c>
item_descs.77771: <c=@flavor>With great fortune, adventurers rediscovered a long-lost recipe from Ashford Abbey, allowing Eldvin Monastery to resurrect this brew. Eldvin Abbey Ale possesses a deep brown color and a unique taste of spices that wonderfully accent the overall flavor.</c>
item_descs.77775: <c=@flavor>The Pale Tree Pilsner was inspired by the Pale Tree herself. This brew is a light, crystal-clear brew, perfect for springtime. The hops provide a perfect balance with the other robust flavors found in this brew.</c>
item_descs.77776: <c=@flavor>Barrel-Aged Ascalonian Amber has a rich flavor that dominates the pallet. The deceptive copper color belies its strong flavors of fruits, oak, and a mild bitterness. This rare, ancient beer is highly sought after by collectors.</c>
item_descs.77781: <c=@flavor>Once a year, Evon Gnashblade opens the vaults and sends out small casks of this reserve to small breweries across Tyria. The aged, rich, full-bodied brew has slight coffee, vanilla, and pecan flavors with a caramel finish that is not overly bitter and not overly sweet.</c>

skin_descs.10244: <c=@flavor>They tethered me to the world. Without them, I'd have floated away.</c>
skin_descs.10251: <c=@flavor>I saw it, in a dream. The great peace... It disgusted me.</c>
skin_descs.10252: <c=@flavor>"Instinct" means you have to do it.</c>
skin_descs.10259: <c=@flavor>In those final moments, she could see them. Some smiled.</c>
skin_descs.10260: <c=@flavor>Think of the terror they all endured, and the wounds they tried to survive...</c>
skin_descs.10266: <c=@flavor>We can use anything that remains of you. Don't justify yourself with a purpose.</c>
skin_descs.10288: <c=@flavor>If this is what you are, be all of it.</c>
skin_descs.10294: <c=@flavor>Have I troubled you? Replace me, then.</c>
skin_descs.10301: <c=@flavor>Why destroy something just to replace it?</c>
skin_descs.10309: <c=@flavor>Her realm was cool and dark; not an empty darkness, but a soft one.</c>
skin_descs.10320: <c=@flavor>This is your true calling. You feel it. You know it.</c>
skin_descs.10324: <c=@flavor>Around her neck its tendrils wrapped. She could feel no more.</c>
skin_descs.10327: <c=@flavor>There is no beauty here. It's obscene.</c>
skin_descs.10329: <c=@flavor>And in his wake there was nothing but crystal and blood.</c>
skin_descs.10332: <c=@flavor>As always, you've left me nothing to mourn.</c>
skin_descs.10343: <c=@flavor>It's so delicate, but it repeats itself forever.</c>
skin_descs.10347: <c=@flavor>If all things have limits, where are mine...?</c>
skin_descs.10350: <c=@flavor>You must have known your history, to relive it over and over...</c>
skin_descs.10355: <c=@flavor>I outgrew them so quickly, she barely had time to mourn my departure...</c>
skin_descs.10358: <c=@flavor>It is poison, yes... But they mean to kill you.</c>
skin_descs.10363: <c=@flavor>It's still alive, do you see? I can undo it.</c>
skin_descs.10366: <c=@flavor>It reached the water, cooled, and stopped.</c>
skin_descs.10381: <c=@flavor>Your eyes lie—life is in eternal motion.</c>
skin_descs.10390: <c=@flavor>It ruins them in seconds and lingers while they scream.</c>
skin_descs.10394: <c=@flavor>In that moment, she didn't look at me with fearful eyes.</c>
skin_descs.10410: <c=@flavor>I no longer recognize myself without it...</c>
skin_descs.10414: <c=@flavor>When her cheek hits the ground, she'll come to understand the cost of betrayal.</c>
skin_descs.10415: <c=@flavor>It's time. Open the door. Now, walk outside.</c>
skin_descs.10417: <c=@flavor>You wallow in entropy and call it renewal.</c>
skin_descs.10422: <c=@flavor>A living being's most primal fear—its antithesis—is death.</c>
skin_descs.10429: <c=@flavor>Her child reached out to me, to my mind. She was curious.</c>
skin_descs.10436: <c=@flavor>It comforts you to believe that. I can wait.</c>
skin_descs.10437: <c=@flavor>Cracks of lightning and dark clouds encompassed him like plated armor.</c>
skin_descs.10448: <c=@flavor>She looked at him with waning eyes. He would be the last to leave her.</c>
skin_descs.10453: <c=@flavor>And then he slept among the rolling hills. A mountain, he lingered there.</c>
skin_descs.10472: <c=@flavor>In every domain, I adapt. I thrive.</c>
skin_descs.10481: <c=@flavor>Soft growth needs armor. It should have been painless.</c>
skin_descs.10490: <c=@flavor>It slithered through her like a wurm in the jungle. It preyed on her.</c>
skin_descs.10496: <c=@flavor>Before there was a "them," there was nothing but swirling stars.</c>
skin_descs.10497: <c=@flavor>Living minds are obsessed with decisions they have no power to make...</c>
skin_descs.10499: <c=@flavor>The truth was...inevitable. And now they know.</c>
skin_descs.10511: <c=@flavor>Every wound, every tear; she felt them live. And die.</c>
skin_descs.10515: <c=@flavor>I can build a world out of the things you're too small to understand.</c>
skin_descs.10517: <c=@flavor>Like all ruins, they become what they are, not what they held.</c>
skin_descs.10521: <c=@flavor>And then there was nothing but dust and shadow.</c>
skin_descs.10525: <c=@flavor>You let this happen. Never forget that.</c>
skin_descs.10537: <c=@flavor>You were wrong... It's endless. I am endless.</c>
skin_descs.10539: <c=@flavor>...but you must act now. No one else can see it; only you.</c>
skin_descs.10541: <c=@flavor>I thought I could go ahead. And you could—</c>
skin_descs.10550: <c=@flavor>Don't step out of the light, little one.</c>
skin_descs.10552: <c=@flavor>The further I reach, the more I understand.</c>
skin_descs.10553: <c=@flavor>Cycles within cycles, grinding everything to dust.</c>
skin_descs.10564: <c=@flavor>Innocent flickers of pure magic, they were. Innocent, but destined.</c>
skin_descs.10570: <c=@flavor>They looked at her with those icy blue eyes. She disappointed them.</c>
skin_descs.10583: <c=@flavor>As the shard impaled her, a scream flickered in his mind.</c>
skin_descs.10596: <c=@flavor>They would know that she knew, and that scared her more than anything.</c>
skin_descs.10601: <c=@flavor>I am the curator of eternity's refuse.</c>
skin_descs.10623: <c=@flavor>I did as any mother would; I wept for them.</c>
skin_descs.10628: <c=@flavor>Small game wasn't enough. He craved more. He craved the fight.</c>
skin_descs.10630: <c=@flavor>Nothing grows where their corpses fell. No, not yet...</c>
skin_descs.10632: <c=@flavor>A flicker of light at the corner of my eye. For a moment, I thought it was her.</c>
skin_descs.10645: <c=@flavor>I can touch it. It doesn't hurt.</c>
skin_descs.10676: <c=@flavor>I never feared the possibility... I never feared anything.</c>
skin_descs.10678: <c=@flavor>The simplicity of living in ruins is that they are what you make of them.</c>
skin_descs.10685: <c=@flavor>The crazed god's lust for power was admirable, albeit misguided.</c>
skin_descs.10693: <c=@flavor>In that final moment, he looked for her.</c>
skin_descs.10711: <c=@flavor>No. Only your stubborn solitude diminishes you.</c>
skin_descs.10716: <c=@flavor>When the egg hatched, she felt the world sigh.</c>
skin_descs.10720: <c=@flavor>"Good night," she whispered. They were little more than speckles of light.</c>
skin_descs.10729: <c=@flavor>A perfect state in which the worst that could happen is already over...</c>
skin_descs.10730: <c=@flavor>The gates have fallen, the walls have crumbled...</c>
skin_descs.10738: <c=@flavor>I didn't notice at first... Perhaps I wasn't looking.</c>
skin_descs.10739: <c=@flavor>I have a purpose for everything you remember.</c>
skin_descs.10747: <c=@flavor>When the birds sing, the rot sets in.</c>

skin_descs.7160: <c=@flavor>From the smallest blade of grass to the largest mountain, where life goes, so too should you.</c>
skin_descs.7161: <c=@flavor>All things have a right to grow. The blossom is brother to the weed.</c>
skin_descs.7162: <c=@flavor>Do not fear difficulty. Hard ground makes stronger roots.</c>
skin_descs.7163: <c=@flavor>The only lasting peace is the peace within your own soul.</c>
skin_descs.7164: <c=@flavor>Never leave a wrong to ripen into evil or sorrow.</c>
